CustomField.description: Minimum log level to capture for application logs. Valid values: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR. Entries below this threshold are silently dropped. DEBUG captures all; ERROR captures only errors. Bypass audit entries ignore this threshold: they are kept while Is Enabled is checked and the BypassAudit_Enabled feature flag is on.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Applies to application logs. Set to ERROR for production, DEBUG for development or troubleshooting. Bypass audit entries are kept at every level while logging is on.
CustomField.label: Log Level Threshold
